correctness.rationale: The moving-frame substitution y=x-vt gives a first-spatial-harmonic Riccati equation under z=tan(y/2), lifted to a trace-zero 2x2 system. The stroboscopic map is PSL(2,R), implying at most two fixed points and reciprocal hyperbolic derivatives; its nontrivial higher-period points cannot attract in isolation. Reversibility R(y)=-y pins simple parabolic folds at y=pi near v=1 and y=0 near v=3. At each fold, solve the periodic first-order forced equation y1=±sin(kv0t)/(kv0), integrate its second-order solvability condition, giving respectively 1/(2k)+1/(4k²) and 1/(6k)-1/(36k²). A half-period time shift conjugates +epsilon to -epsilon and forces even analytic folds. Bounding all locked speeds in [1-|epsilon|,3+|epsilon|] plus compact continuation excludes remote fixed branches. Independent numerical shooting checked coefficients for eight (k,epsilon) combinations; no quantitative statement relies solely on finite checks.
